questions.question: Which quality describes entrepreneurs who have dreams of what the future could be like for their business?
questions.explanation: Vision is the quality of having dreams for the future of the business.

questions.question: Which quality describes entrepreneurs who are not into procrastination and make decisions promptly?
questions.explanation: Decisiveness means making decisions promptly without procrastination.

questions.question: Which quality describes entrepreneurs who never give up when confronted by overwhelming challenges?

questions.question: Which quality describes entrepreneurs who are totally dedicated to their business sometimes at cost to family and friends?

questions.question: Which quality describes entrepreneurs who must be on top of the critical details of starting and growing a business?
questions.explanation: Details means being on top of critical business details.

questions.question: Which quality describes entrepreneurs who must love their initiatives that generate new products and services?
questions.explanation: Devotion is the love for initiatives that generate new products and services.

questions.question: Which quality describes entrepreneurs who are doers of courses of action and implement ideas quickly?
questions.explanation: Performers implement ideas as quickly as possible.

questions.question: How many micro, small and medium enterprises operated in Nigeria as at December 2020?
questions.explanation: At least 39,654,385 MSMEs operated in Nigeria as at December 2020.
